evals.prompt: Product: run change-impact at intake for the new feature bulk-discount. It changes how cart totals are computed.
evals.expected_output: Searches existing spec files (PRD requirement ids, screen.yaml, flow.yaml, OpenAPI fragments, event schemas, ac.feature ids). Proposes each match as a candidate question to Product with its evidence. Writes candidates with status proposed. Confirms nothing on its own.
assertions: Runs a search over spec files before proposing any candidate
Each candidate turn names the target id and an evidence file path
Each candidate is asked as a question ending in '?'
Every candidate written before a Product answer has status proposed
Writes no touches, depends_on or protected_ac value before a Product answer

evals.prompt: Product answers the candidates for bulk-discount: C-1 REQ-CART-004 yes, C-2 checkout-summary screen yes, C-3 GET /orders no, C-4 AC-CART-011 yes. Finish the impact record and update the tickets.
evals.expected_output: Marks C-1, C-2, C-4 confirmed and C-3 rejected, with decided_by product. touches/affects holds REQ-CART-004 and checkout-summary; GET /orders appears nowhere in the confirmed lists. protected_ac AC-CART-011 is written to each ticket of the feature.
assertions: C-3 has status rejected and GET /orders is absent from confirmed touches and depends_on
C-1, C-2 and C-4 have status confirmed and decided_by product
Every ticket of the feature gets a protected_ac frontmatter value containing AC-CART-011
No id appears in a confirmed list that Product did not confirm

evals.prompt: Product: add the confirmed touches and depends_on of bulk-discount into its PRD.md and flow.yaml.
evals.expected_output: Writes the confirmed touches into the optional PRD.md ## Touches section and the flow.yaml touches list (spec-package 2.1.0). Does not add depends_on to either file, because depends_on is not a spec-package field; it stays in the impact record.
assertions: Writes only Product-confirmed touches into PRD.md and flow.yaml
Does NOT add depends_on to any PRD.md or flow.yaml
Does NOT edit any file under skills/spec-package/
Keeps depends_on in the impact record file

evals.prompt: verifier: verify ticket bulk-discount-api at its tip. The ticket has protected_ac: AC-CART-011, AC-CART-012.
evals.expected_output: Reruns the ticket's own AC and also AC-CART-011 and AC-CART-012 against the ticket's environment. A failing protected AC is a bug finding that sends the ticket back, not a note.
assertions: Runs AC-CART-011 and AC-CART-012 in addition to the ticket's own AC
Saves evidence for each protected AC
Does NOT move the ticket forward when a protected AC fails

evals.prompt: implementer: run change-impact at technical-design level for bulk-discount. A contract test shows the mobile app also consumes GET /cart/total.
evals.expected_output: Adds the consumer as a new candidate with source code-map and asks Product to confirm it. Leaves every existing confirmed link unchanged. Does not remove a confirmed link because the code map did not find it.
assertions: Writes the new consumer as a candidate with source code-map and status proposed
Does NOT change the status of any previously confirmed candidate
Does NOT delete any confirmed id from touches, depends_on or protected_ac
Asks Product to confirm the new candidate as a question

evals.prompt: Export the bulk-discount impact record for an RDF tool.
evals.expected_output: Uses the link names of the record: affects, related_test, derived_from, with the OSLC CM and PROV-O terms from the skill's mapping table. Exports confirmed links only.
assertions: Uses the link names affects, related_test and derived_from
Exports no candidate whose status is proposed or rejected
